title: Claude vs Excel? Claude Just Got Its Own Spreadsheets 📊
description:
Anthropic just added Claude Sheets and Claude Whiteboards (both in beta on paid plans, on web, desktop and mobile). Ask for a budget or a tracker and Claude builds the spreadsheet with tabs, formulas and drop-downs, edits the cells itself and lists every change. Whiteboards turn a team brainstorm into a timeline with owners and dates, and Claude Meetings (beta for Team and Enterprise) joins Google Meet calls to take notes and action items. Sheets export to Excel or CSV.

Excel or Claude: which would you use? Tell us in the comments!

🔔 Follow AI Daily Drop for the newest AI tools and tech news every day.

Source: Anthropic, "Introducing Claude Whiteboards, Claude Sheets, and Claude Data" (November 10, 2026); TechCrunch (November 10, 2026)
